name: ICSSR Full-Term Doctoral Fellowship (Social and Human Sciences)
provider: Indian Council of Social Science Research (Ministry of Education)

rules.quote: Doctoral Fellow should be a full-time bonafide Ph.D. student at the affiliating university/ institution throughout the duration of fellowship tenure.
The candidate must not be more than 40 years of age on the last date of application.
The candidate must have secured a minimum of 55% marks in Post-Graduation or equivalent grades in any social science discipline.

value: UGC NET (up to 10% of awards may go to non-NET candidates)
rules.quote: UGC NET will be mandatory for applying for ICSSR Doctoral Fellowship Schemes.

rules.value: not for those who already hold JRF/RGNF/MANF/ICSSR/ICAR/CSIR/ICPR/ICMR/ICHR/JNMF or similar major doctoral fellowship
rules.quote: Candidates who have already availed UGC Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) / Rajiv Gandhi National Fellowship (RGNF) / Maulana Azad National Fellowship (MANF) / ICSSR / ICAR / CSIR/ ICPR / ICMR / ICHR / Jawaharlal Nehru Memorial Foundation Fund Fellowship (JNMF) or any such major doctoral fellowship are not eligible to apply.

amount.text: Rs 20,000 per month plus Rs 20,000 contingency per annum for two years
amount.quote: The value of Full-Term Doctoral Fellowship is Rs 20,000 per month plus Rs 20,000 contingency grant per annum.

documents.name: Self-attested educational qualification (incl. UGC NET) and proof of date of birth
documents.quote: Self-attested copies of educational qualification (including UGC NET) and proof of date of birth (Birth Certificate/Secondary School Certificate /Higher Secondary School Certificate) must be uploaded with the application form.

deadline.text: Last date extended to 4 August 2026 (FY 2026-27 call)
deadline.quote: Extension of Last Date for Online Application Submission to August 04, 2026
